name: WPGreeks CPT
author: wpgreeks

sections.description:
WPGreeks CPT is a powerful and user-friendly plugin designed to help you create, organize, and manage Custom Post Types (CPTs) and Custom Taxonomies in WordPress — without writing a single line of code.

Whether you’re a blogger, agency, developer, or business owner, this plugin brings complete flexibility to your content structure with a modern admin UI and advanced customization options.

🔥 Key Features

  • Custom Post Types (CPTs): Create and manage unlimited custom post types for portfolios, testimonials, events, products, services, and more.
  • Custom Taxonomies: Build hierarchical or non-hierarchical taxonomies for better content categorization.
  • Modern Admin UI: A clean, fast, and intuitive dashboard design that enhances your WordPress backend experience.
  • Drag-and-Drop Widget Builder: Build dynamic widgets effortlessly with drag-and-drop control.
  • Dynamic Content Filtering: Display relevant content using custom titles, descriptions, and filter logic.
  • Template Support: Maintain design consistency with theme-compatible templates.
  • Import Functionality: Import previously generated CPT code created using this plugin.
  • Developer Friendly: Includes hooks, filters, and extendable architecture.

Take complete control of your content structure and create a more organized, scalable, and professional WordPress experience.

Privacy Policy

WPGreeks CPT is designed to respect user privacy and complies with GDPR.
With default settings, the plugin does not:

  • store personal data
  • track users
  • send data to external servers
  • use cookies
sections.installation:
Install via WordPress Search

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for WPGreeks CPT.
  4. Click Install Now → Activate.
  5. Access plugin settings under the WPGreeks CPT menu.

Install via ZIP Upload

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the wpgreeks-cpt.zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Configure your CPTs and Taxonomies from the plugin dashboard.
sections.faq:
What is WPGreeks CPT used for?

WPGreeks CPT allows you to create, edit, and manage custom post types and taxonomies, helping you organize your website content exactly the way you want.

Can I create unlimited Custom Post Types?

Yes. You can create as many custom post types as your website needs.

Does the plugin support custom taxonomies?

Absolutely. You can create both hierarchical (like categories) and non-hierarchical (like tags) taxonomies.

Do I need coding experience to use this plugin?

No. WPGreeks CPT is designed for beginners as well as developers. Its user-friendly interface lets anyone create post types and taxonomies easily.

Is the plugin compatible with all themes?

Yes. The plugin follows WordPress coding standards and is compatible with all properly built WordPress themes.

Does it include widgets?

Yes. WPGreeks CPT includes customizable widgets and a drag-and-drop widget builder for dynamic content display.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. WPGreeks CPT is optimized for performance, ensuring minimal load on your WordPress setup.

How do I get support?

You can reach out through the support forum on WordPress.org or contact the plugin developer for assistance.

Is WPGreeks CPT regularly updated?

Yes. The plugin receives regular updates to ensure compatibility, security, and new features.
